mapper.update: UPDATE campus_report_generation_log SET report_id = #{reportId}, run_status = #{runStatus}, end_time = NOW(), duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE generation_log_id = #{generationLogId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, generation_log_id, report_job_id, report_id, generation_mode, run_status, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, error_message, create_user_id, create_time FROM campus_report_generation_log WHERE generation_log_id = #{generationLogId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, generation_log_id, report_job_id, report_id, generation_mode, run_status, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, error_message, create_user_id, create_time FROM campus_report_generation_log WHERE report_job_id = #{reportJobId} ORDER BY id DESC
